players.product: CRPS / M-CRPS server power supplies (incl. 3200W CRPS for AI data centers) and industrial PSUs

quarterly_data.quarter: FSP Technology press release: FSP Unveils Next-Generation USB PD External Power Supplies (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FSP introduced four new USB Type-C PD external power adapters from 100W to 240W, all compliant with the EU common charger and external power supply regulation (EU) 2025/2052, with 90-264 VAC input: FSP100-A2BR3 (100W; also certified under IEC 62368-1 PS2), FSP140-A3BR3 (140W, USB PD 3.2), FSP240-A3BR3 / FSP240-A3CR3 (240W, USB PD 3.2 EPR) and FSP240-A4BR3 (240W, peak load capability), for laptops, workstations, docking stations, e-Bikes and industrial devices.
